name: Slides
description: Create presentations with text, shapes, images, themes and speaker notes. Edit and present native Nautilo documents.

agent.instructions:
For a new presentation, use create-file first; no blank document needs to be open. Inspect and populate its returned target using inspect-presentation and edit-presentation, then offer the creation result’s Open in Slides button. opened=false means the saved deck is ready to open, not that creation failed. Never ask the Human to create the blank file or copy a path. A destination_exists refusal preserves the existing file: choose another filename or inspect the existing document according to intent. Use native presentation tools to complete the Human's presentation, including design. Inspect the exact source first: view=summary measures scope, view=resources returns themes/layouts/masters, view=document returns the full native model, and view=slides returns selected slide data. Omitting pageSize returns full selected content; when paging, follow nextCursor until the intended selection is complete. describe-authoring returns generated native model definitions and an explicit full-schema option. Use the returned versionToken as expectedVersion for open edits, or expectedSha256 for closed edits. The host owns open-document targeting, session and idempotency. On stale refusal, inspect again and reconsider; never overwrite an unsaved Human draft.
Use op=patch with JSON Pointer add/remove/replace/copy/move/test to edit any native model fields, including rich text runs, arbitrary supported fonts/colors/fills, images/crop, charts/data, tables, groups, connectors, transitions, themes, masters and layouts. This is data editing, not JavaScript. Use test preconditions for addressed IDs/values and preserve unrelated fields. A batch is validated completely and saved once, or writes nothing. The full native model schema, reference integrity and image authority are the boundaries; there is no creative property allowlist. Use deterministic helpers where bookkeeping matters: add-slide/add-element allocate identities; duplicate-slide and insert-template remap copied identities/resources; apply-theme and apply-layout execute engine cascades; group-elements/ungroup-element preserve transforms. Schema errors identify paths to repair.
For images, use insert-image with an authorized asset reference or Workspace/Current Folder target and the desired native element frame/data; host code resolves exact bytes. Omit element.id and element.data.src for insert-image: the helper generates the identity and supplies the source. add-element also requires element.id to be omitted. Do not generate or pass base64 yourself. Browse inspect-slide-templates before insert-template. Use save-open-template for a selected inspected open slide; manage-slide-template saves from an inspected saved source or removes an entry. Library deletion leaves inserted copies intact. Built-in themes are suggestions; custom themes and native fields remain editable via patch. Existing text/notes/title/shape shortcuts are conveniences only. set-text supports uniform text; for mixed formatting edit exact native runs. set-notes intentionally replaces with plain text.
Review the visible resulting presentation, saved receipt and any warnings before claiming completion. PowerPoint conversion produces separate copies and reports fidelity limits; keep the source. PDF export requires actual bytes prepared by the open editor and is rasterized; never invent prepared output. A failed or uncertain write requires canonical reinspection before retrying. Choose content, typography, layout and narrative using the Human's intent; leave hashes, geometry bookkeeping, media bytes, validation and transactions to code.

tools.title: Create presentation and open
tools.description: Create a saved native presentation without requiring an open blank deck. Never overwrites an existing filename. Returns its target for inspect-presentation/edit-presentation and an Open in Slides action for the Human. Use a basename ending in .presentation.html. The editor opens when the Human clicks the action; do not claim it is already open.

openAfterCreate.description: Legacy flag accepted for compatibility. Creation never navigates automatically; the result always offers an Open in Slides action.

tools.title: Inspect presentation
tools.description: Read exact slide contents from a closed native presentation. Choose pageSize and follow same-selection, same-version nextCursor until complete. Choose summary for measured scope, document for the full native model, resources for actual themes/layouts/masters, or slides for exact selected slides. Omitting pageSize returns all selected slides; supplying it requests version-bound pagination. No hidden truncation.

tools.title: Edit presentation
tools.description: Apply one atomic batch to a closed presentation, using expectedSha256 from inspection. Stale content is refused. set-text preserves supported plain text formatting; set-notes replaces notes with plain text. update-shape patches geometry or solid fill of an inspected top-level shape; frames use native slide units and radians. General native patch edits support every model field, including rich text, fonts, images, charts, tables, groups, connectors, themes and layouts. Use describe-authoring for the generated model schema. All operations commit once or not at all. Helpers handle copied identities, resource bytes and derived geometry.

frame.description: Patch inspected top-level shape geometry in native slide units; rotation is radians. Omitted values are preserved.

fill.description: Explicitly replace the shape fill with this solid RGB color; other styling is preserved.

element.description: Native element frame/data. Omit id: the helper generates it. For insert-image also omit data.src: the host resolves exact image bytes.
Native element frame/data. Omit id: the helper generates it. For insert-image also omit data.src: the host resolves exact image bytes.

asset.description: Exactly one source: pinned artifact ref, workspace surface+path, or currentFolder surface+relativePath. The host authorizes and reads the bytes.

tools.title: Inspect open presentation
tools.description: Inspect exact canonical slide contents of the active presentation. Follow same-selection, same-version nextCursor until complete. The host supplies session binding. Choose summary for measured scope, document for the full native model, resources for actual themes/layouts/masters, or slides for exact selected slides. Omitting pageSize returns all selected slides; supplying it requests version-bound pagination. No hidden truncation.

tools.title: Edit open presentation
tools.description: Apply one atomic batch to the active presentation. expectedVersion must equal the prior inspection versionToken. The host owns active document, approval and idempotency; no target or session parameters are accepted. set-text preserves supported plain text formatting; set-notes replaces notes with plain text. update-shape patches geometry or solid fill of an inspected top-level shape; frames use native slide units and radians. General native patch edits support every model field, including rich text, fonts, images, charts, tables, groups, connectors, themes and layouts. Use describe-authoring for the generated model schema. All operations commit once or not at all. Helpers handle copied identities, resource bytes and derived geometry.

tools.title: Import PowerPoint
tools.description: Import a Workspace or Current Folder PowerPoint file into Workspace as an editable native copy. Review returned warnings and retry with acknowledgedSourceSha256 only after accepting conversion differences. Original is preserved.

tools.title: Export PowerPoint
tools.description: Export a saved native presentation to a separate PowerPoint file. Review returned warnings and retry with acknowledgedSourceSha256 only after accepting conversion differences. Original is preserved.

workspaceDestination.description: Workspace exports only: current creates in the current chat workspace; source creates beside the original and requires create authority there. Omission preserves source placement.

tools.title: Save prepared PDF
tools.description: Save PDF bytes prepared by the open Slides editor after source-hash verification and explicit fidelity warning acknowledgment. Closed-document PDF rendering is unavailable.
